subject.title: fix: user-pinned model falls back to global chain on quota exhaustion

question: Should persisted user and legacy model pins remain exact selections, or may they fall back through configured chains when the selected model hits long-term quota or subscription limits?
rationale: Current docs and tests define user selections as strict, while this PR deliberately changes provider/auth routing for persisted session state; code review can identify the safe mechanics, but the fallback contract needs maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept quota-only fallback after repair
options.body: Treat user pins as strict for transient failures but allow configured fallback on long-term quota/subscription limits once the cooldown and matcher blockers are fixed and proven.

options.title: Keep exact pins strict
options.body: Reject this behavior change and keep user-selected models from falling through to configured fallbacks, even for long reset windows.

options.title: Move to explicit fallback policy
options.body: Require an opt-in policy/config shape before user-pinned sessions can route to alternate providers or auth profiles.

recommendation.title: Accept quota-only fallback after repair
recommendation.body: Treat user pins as strict for transient failures but allow configured fallback on long-term quota/subscription limits once the cooldown and matcher blockers are fixed and proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to steipete as the strongest owner of the strict selection contract, fallback docs, and adjacent fallback runtime surfaces.
